new_results.statement: If S has density cap K, (C,D) is independent of S with joint density cap M, and R is independent of (S,C,D), then T=2 beta S C+F(R,C)+2 h(R,C)D+gamma D^2 has density cap at most 3(2MK)^(2/3)|beta^2 gamma|^(-1/3).

For disjoint original left source banks feeding the two SVD cross directions and one common right product bank feeding an orthogonal projected pair, the SVD-aligned two-right-direction chamber has ||p_Q||inf<9.964/s3(H), retaining the nonzero second cross tail exactly.

Q_eps=2SC+2 eps RD+D^2 with 0<eps<1 has exactly three eigenvalues of modulus at least one, s3=1, and ||p_Qeps||inf<=3*2^(5/3)=9.524406311809198 for all admissible cap-one product laws under the stated disjoint-left/common-right provenance.

primary_sources.verified_scope: independent real scalar inputs with density cap K; normalized linear combination density cap sqrt(2)K; no iid/moment/support/centering/symmetry/smoothness/log-concavity assumption
genuine product density; cap-one k-dimensional orthogonal marginal <=2^(k/2); joint marginal cap only, no projected independence

primary_sources.citation: Banks--Garza Vargas--Kulkarni--Srivastava, arXiv:2005.08930, Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.4
primary_sources.verified_scope: bilinear-affine quadratic-form density packet for independent-entry bounded-density banks; does not literally include arbitrary same-bank moving square gamma D^2+2h(R,C)D

partner_results_applied.use: In the SVD-aligned 2D right chamber gives |gamma|>=(s3-d2)_+; combined with d1>=s3 and cross payment yields ||p_Q||inf<9.964/s3.
After paying the one-sided-overlap core, any further source-separated remainder is added by exact convolution without increasing the L-infinity bound.
